book.specutils.guidebook.ender_flasks.pa: The Ender Flask can hold as much [Ink](entry://ink/ink) as an [Ink Flask](entry://ink/ink_flask), but can only hold [Ink](entry://ink/ink) of that one color. When first crafted, the Ender Flask does nothing. I have to use it to bind it to myself first, after which all Ender Flasks of the same color bound to me will act as the same Ink source.
Works with any color of [Pigment](entry://general/pigment) to give me a matching Ender Flask.
book.specutils.guidebook.auxiliary_ink_s:
The Auxiliary Ink Supplier allow me to connect an [Ink](entry://ink/ink)-containing item to an [Ink](entry://ink/ink) storage of any of my constructs.\
\
As an example, I can use it to automatically supply a [Cinderhearth](entry://ink/cinderhearth) with multiple colors of Ink with ease.
Has a max distance of 3 blocks. I can use my trusty [Paintbrush](entry://general/paintbrush) to link it to its target.
book.specutils.guidebook.moonstone_grow_:
I struggled a lot getting [Jade Vines](entry://general/jade_vines) to grow in places where they can't access natural moonlight.\
A Moonstone Grow Lamp directly above a [Jade Vine's](entry://general/jade_vines) roots, powered with Redstone will provide the plant with enough soft, moonlight-like light to allow it to grow, as if exposed to the Moon.

Moving a block of [Shimmerstone](entry://general/shimmerstone) directly on top of the Moonstone Grow Lamp will overcharge it, causing the [Jade Vines](entry://general/jade_vines) beneath to die, as if in sunlight.
